mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and may reduce piroxicam levels; concurrent use increases GI bleeding risk from NSAIDs and may elevate anticonvulsant levels variably through hepatic metabolism changes.
action: Monitor for reduced piroxicam efficacy and GI adverse effects; consider alternative analgesic with lower GI risk or ensure gastroprotection with proton pump inhibitor; monitor anticonvulsant levels.
